name: Evidence Lane
short_description: Governed project evidence with durable memory and human-controlled acceptance.
long_description: Evidence Lane turns authorized project sources and visible AI-task lineage into inspectable, content-sealed evidence packages. It keeps candidates separate from accepted truth, preserves exact source identity and pointer history, resumes exact unfinished work through verified State Travel, and requires an explicit six-way human-in-the-loop decision before promotion.

interactive_ui.host_boundary: Evidence Lane supplies supported in-conversation panels; ChatGPT owns its native listing and settings layout.

host_contracts.codex: Exact-Git full lifecycle. Plan Lane may project to Codex native Plan mode, Goal, and task panel through a user-mediated /pl and /evi-plan flow.
host_contracts.chatgpt_pro: Exact 21-tool read-only MCP accelerator. ChatGPT native ENV/UOP and Project Mutation remain host-owned and are not MCP mutations. Vercel and the owned HTTPS domain are ChatGPT-only.

read_safe_workflows: Root routing and exact six-control presentation
Boot ENV/UOP Flash, runtime and accepted-PV observation
Accepted-PV Entry and Exit Slip observation
Lane, search, diff, backlog and governed-panel guidance
Mode, storage and lifecycle-law explanation without mutation

release_propagation: GitHub Markdown, all relevant website pages and footers, the website Delta table, Vercel production from main, and existing Devpost project 1348634/evidence_os must resolve from the same accepted release evidence.
